name: Save close probe
description: Reports modified tab state independently of a successful save reply.

status.name: probeclose.state
status.description: The save count of the tab, kept in the local storage of the view under its surface id so that it survives a reload of the tab, and the reported modified state.

commands.name: probeclose.prepare
commands.description: Marks the tab modified and chooses whether its next save retains changes.

commands.name: probeclose.save
commands.description: Completes a save and reports the configured modified state.
